abstract: Analyses of cell-cycle characteristics of the three embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines F9, PCC3 N/1 and PCC4 Azal, have been performed. The three lines reflect successive stages in early mouse embryogenesis as regards cell surface antigens and cell-cycle characteristics. In an attempt to understand changes in cell-cycle characteristics occurring during early embryogenesis, the two-random transition probability (TP) model was applied to the EC-cell system--and particularly to the F9 line. By utilizing an intraclonal heterogeneity in intermitotic times found in these EC lines, a growth-regulating point was introduced as a modification of the two-random TP model. The modified model was found to be very useful when demonstrating the cell-cycle growth kinetics of the F9 line. The model is used in an accompanying paper to extend the analysis of cell-cycle characteristics in undifferentiated EC cells.
abstract_ja: マウス初期胚発生の連続した段階を、細胞表面抗原と細胞周期特性の点で反映する3種の胎児性癌（EC）細胞株F9、PCC3 N/1、PCC4 Azalについて、細胞周期特性の解析を行った。初期胚発生における細胞周期特性の変化を理解するため、EC細胞系に2ランダム遷移確率（TP）モデルを適用し、特にF9株について検討した。ECの各細胞株にみられる分裂間期時間のクローン内不均一性を利用し、2ランダム遷移確率モデルに成長制御点を導入して修正した。修正モデルはF9株の細胞周期成長動態を示すのに非常に有用であることがわかった。
